analysis.summary: Today's tech and business headlines highlight several significant stories. In the realm of tech, Meta is facing allegations from whistleblowers regarding potential child safety issues they allegedly covered up. Robinhood is exploring copy trading, and Apple has introduced a new N1 wireless chip in their latest iPhones. In the business sector, Novo Nordisk plans to cut 9,000 jobs and Donald Trump is reportedly lobbying for high tariffs on China and India. Contactless card payments may soon see unlimited transactions. Other notable news includes protests in Nepal leading to a lifted social media ban, Russian air strikes intensifying in Ukraine, and AI training startup Mercor potentially reaching a $10B+ valuation.
